name: ai-talk
description: AI Talk compiles ambiguous development requests into executable RequirementContract 1.0 handoffs with acceptance criteria, and performs bounded fault triage with live browser evidence before authorized implementation.

interface.longDescription: AI Talk asks only questions that change implementation scope or behavior, then emits a machine-readable RequirementContract 1.0 with observable acceptance criteria. Diagnostic requests first use bounded read-only inspection across control, data, and render layers, including live browser evidence for UI failures. When the user says execute, the current code Agent inherits the contract, implements, and verifies without repeating clarification or routing to another Skill.
capabilities: Live browser evidence for UI failures
DOM, geometry, occlusion, and resource inspection
defaultPrompt: $ai-talk 这两部分的用户头像都需要 pag/user 溜光
$ai-talk 开发一个弹窗，帮我编译成可执行、可验收的任务契约
$ai-talk 最后一个奖励需要显示领取按钮，修改后还是没有
